# MCP reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-tools-doc.mjs from the running server. Do not edit by hand. -->

14 tools, all **read-only** (`readOnlyHint: true`). Every tool returns
`structuredContent` (JSON matching its output schema) plus the same JSON as text. Errors are
returned as results with `isError: true` and a body `{ "error": { "code", "message", "hint" } }`.

Error codes: `AUTH_REQUIRED`, `PERMISSION_DENIED`, `RATE_LIMITED`, `NOT_FOUND`,
`INVALID_ARGUMENT`, `UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY`, `NETATMO_UNAVAILABLE`, `INVALID_RESPONSE`.

Conventions: temperatures in °C, durations in minutes, times in ISO 8601 with the home UTC
offset, `null` = not reported by Netatmo. Periods: `today`, `yesterday`, `last_24h`,
`last_7d`, `last_30d` (home time zone), or `from`/`to` ISO 8601.

## Discovery

### `netatmo_list_homes`

List the homes in the Netatmo account that have Energy devices (thermostats, radiator valves), with room and device counts and whether boiler history is available.

No arguments.

Returns: `homes`.

### `netatmo_get_home`

Details of one home: heating mode, schedules, rooms and devices (topology only; use the status tools for live values).

| Argument | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `home_id` | string (≤ 128 chars) | Home ID from netatmo_list_homes. Optional when the account has a single home. |

Returns: `id`, `name`, `timezone`, `room_count`, `device_count`, `device_summary`, `heating_mode`, `boiler_history_available`, `temperature_control_mode`, `default_manual_duration_min`, `schedules`, `rooms`, `devices`.

### `netatmo_list_rooms`

List the rooms of a home with their IDs, types and the devices installed in each.

| Argument | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `home_id` | string (≤ 128 chars) | Home ID from netatmo_list_homes. Optional when the account has a single home. |

Returns: `home`, `rooms`.

### `netatmo_list_devices`

List thermostats, radiator valves and relays/gateways of a home with their model, room and gateway. Use netatmo_get_device_status for battery, signal and reachability.

| Argument | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `home_id` | string (≤ 128 chars) | Home ID from netatmo_list_homes. Optional when the account has a single home. |

Returns: `home`, `devices`.

## Current status

### `netatmo_get_home_status`

Current temperature, setpoint, mode and heating demand of every room, boiler on/off, and alerts (unreachable devices, low batteries, open windows).

| Argument | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `home_id` | string (≤ 128 chars) | Home ID from netatmo_list_homes. Optional when the account has a single home. |

Returns: `home`, `observed_at`, `heating_mode`, `boiler_on`, `rooms`, `alerts`.

### `netatmo_get_room_status`

Current measured temperature and target temperature (setpoint) of one room, with setpoint mode, heating demand and open-window state. Identify the room by room_id or room_name.

| Argument | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `home_id` | string (≤ 128 chars) | Home ID from netatmo_list_homes. Optional when the account has a single home. |
| `room_id` | string (≤ 128 chars) | Room ID from netatmo_list_rooms. |
| `room_name` | string (≤ 128 chars) | Room name (case- and accent-insensitive). Use room_id or room_name. |

Returns: `home`, `observed_at`, `room`.

### `netatmo_get_heating_status`

Whether the boiler is currently requested to heat, which rooms request heat (heating demand %), and anticipation. Demand is not boiler power or energy use.

| Argument | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `home_id` | string (≤ 128 chars) | Home ID from netatmo_list_homes. Optional when the account has a single home. |

Returns: `home`, `observed_at`, `heating_mode`, `boiler_on`, `boiler_source`, `rooms_requesting_heat`, `rooms`, `caveats`.

### `netatmo_get_device_status`

Battery, radio/Wi-Fi signal, reachability, firmware and error codes of all devices of a home, or of one device.

| Argument | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `home_id` | string (≤ 128 chars) | Home ID from netatmo_list_homes. Optional when the account has a single home. |
| `device_id` | string (≤ 128 chars) | Device ID from netatmo_list_devices. Omit for all devices. |

Returns: `home`, `observed_at`, `devices`.

## History

### `netatmo_get_temperature_history`

Measured temperature history of a room with statistics (min, max, mean, variability) and coverage/gaps. Default: last 24 h, aggregated. Missing data is reported, never filled in.

| Argument | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `home_id` | string (≤ 128 chars) | Home ID from netatmo_list_homes. Optional when the account has a single home. |
| `room_id` | string (≤ 128 chars) | Room ID from netatmo_list_rooms. |
| `room_name` | string (≤ 128 chars) | Room name (case- and accent-insensitive). Use room_id or room_name. |
| `period` | `today` \| `yesterday` \| `last_24h` \| `last_7d` \| `last_30d` | Named period in the home time zone. Alternative to from/to. |
| `from` | string (≤ 40 chars) | Range start, ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-01-15 or 2026-01-15T07:30). Without an offset it is read in the home time zone. |
| `to` | string (≤ 40 chars) | Range end, ISO 8601. Defaults to now when "from" is given. |
| `scale` | `auto` \| `30min` \| `1hour` \| `3hours` \| `1day` \| `1week` \| `1month` | Measurement resolution. "auto" (default) picks the finest scale that fits the range. |
| `mode` | `summary` \| `aggregated` \| `detailed` | summary = statistics only; aggregated (default) = statistics + up to max_points buckets; detailed = raw values (bounded). |
| `max_points` | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 1000) | Maximum buckets/points returned (default 48 aggregated, 200 detailed). |

Returns: `home`, `range`, `scale`, `mode`, `coverage`, `requests`, `notes`, `room`, `measure`, `unit`, `stats`, `buckets`, `points`, `changes`, `truncated`.

### `netatmo_get_setpoint_history`

Target temperature (setpoint) history of a room, including the periods during which each setpoint applied. Default: last 24 h.

| Argument | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `home_id` | string (≤ 128 chars) | Home ID from netatmo_list_homes. Optional when the account has a single home. |
| `room_id` | string (≤ 128 chars) | Room ID from netatmo_list_rooms. |
| `room_name` | string (≤ 128 chars) | Room name (case- and accent-insensitive). Use room_id or room_name. |
| `period` | `today` \| `yesterday` \| `last_24h` \| `last_7d` \| `last_30d` | Named period in the home time zone. Alternative to from/to. |
| `from` | string (≤ 40 chars) | Range start, ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-01-15 or 2026-01-15T07:30). Without an offset it is read in the home time zone. |
| `to` | string (≤ 40 chars) | Range end, ISO 8601. Defaults to now when "from" is given. |
| `scale` | `auto` \| `30min` \| `1hour` \| `3hours` \| `1day` \| `1week` \| `1month` | Measurement resolution. "auto" (default) picks the finest scale that fits the range. |
| `mode` | `summary` \| `aggregated` \| `detailed` | summary = statistics only; aggregated (default) = statistics + up to max_points buckets; detailed = raw values (bounded). |
| `max_points` | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 1000) | Maximum buckets/points returned (default 48 aggregated, 200 detailed). |

Returns: `home`, `range`, `scale`, `mode`, `coverage`, `requests`, `notes`, `room`, `measure`, `unit`, `stats`, `buckets`, `points`, `changes`, `truncated`.

### `netatmo_get_boiler_history`

How long the thermostat requested heat from the boiler over a period (minutes and share of time), per bucket. Requires a Netatmo thermostat. This is heat-demand time, not gas or energy consumption. Default: yesterday.

| Argument | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `home_id` | string (≤ 128 chars) | Home ID from netatmo_list_homes. Optional when the account has a single home. |
| `period` | `today` \| `yesterday` \| `last_24h` \| `last_7d` \| `last_30d` | Named period in the home time zone. Alternative to from/to. |
| `from` | string (≤ 40 chars) | Range start, ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-01-15 or 2026-01-15T07:30). Without an offset it is read in the home time zone. |
| `to` | string (≤ 40 chars) | Range end, ISO 8601. Defaults to now when "from" is given. |
| `scale` | `auto` \| `1hour` \| `3hours` \| `1day` \| `1week` \| `1month` | Resolution. "auto" (default): 1hour up to 2 days, 1day up to 93 days, else 1week. |
| `mode` | `summary` \| `aggregated` \| `detailed` | summary = statistics only; aggregated (default) = statistics + up to max_points buckets; detailed = raw values (bounded). |
| `max_points` | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 1000) | Maximum buckets/points returned (default 48 aggregated, 200 detailed). |

Returns: `home`, `range`, `scale`, `mode`, `coverage`, `requests`, `notes`, `thermostat_type`, `total_heat_demand_minutes`, `heat_demand_fraction`, `buckets`, `truncated`, `caveats`.

## Analytics

### `netatmo_get_heating_summary`

Per-room temperature statistics, mean setpoint, time below / within / above target, largest temperature drop and cool-down rate, plus total boiler heat-demand time. Default: yesterday. Deterministic calculations; no energy or gas figures.

| Argument | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `home_id` | string (≤ 128 chars) | Home ID from netatmo_list_homes. Optional when the account has a single home. |
| `room_id` | string (≤ 128 chars) | Room ID from netatmo_list_rooms. |
| `room_name` | string (≤ 128 chars) | Limit to one room (default: all rooms) |
| `period` | `today` \| `yesterday` \| `last_24h` \| `last_7d` \| `last_30d` | Named period in the home time zone. Alternative to from/to. |
| `from` | string (≤ 40 chars) | Range start, ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-01-15 or 2026-01-15T07:30). Without an offset it is read in the home time zone. |
| `to` | string (≤ 40 chars) | Range end, ISO 8601. Defaults to now when "from" is given. |

Returns: `home`, `range`, `scale`, `requests`, `notes`, `caveats`, `overall`, `boiler`, `rooms`.

### `netatmo_compare_rooms`

Compare all rooms over a period (default: last 7 days): warmest/coolest, most variable, most time below target, largest drop and fastest cool-down after setpoint decreases. Returns per-room metrics and rankings.

| Argument | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `home_id` | string (≤ 128 chars) | Home ID from netatmo_list_homes. Optional when the account has a single home. |
| `period` | `today` \| `yesterday` \| `last_24h` \| `last_7d` \| `last_30d` | Named period in the home time zone. Alternative to from/to. |
| `from` | string (≤ 40 chars) | Range start, ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-01-15 or 2026-01-15T07:30). Without an offset it is read in the home time zone. |
| `to` | string (≤ 40 chars) | Range end, ISO 8601. Defaults to now when "from" is given. |

Returns: `home`, `range`, `scale`, `requests`, `notes`, `caveats`, `rooms`, `rankings`.

### `netatmo_detect_anomalies`

Rule-based detection of unusual readings in 30-minute room data (default: last 24 h, at most 14 days): implausible values or jumps, constant readings, missing data, rapid drops at a constant setpoint, sustained deviation from the setpoint. Each finding has severity, confidence, evidence and an explanation; findings are observations, not diagnoses.

| Argument | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `home_id` | string (≤ 128 chars) | Home ID from netatmo_list_homes. Optional when the account has a single home. |
| `room_id` | string (≤ 128 chars) | Room ID from netatmo_list_rooms. |
| `room_name` | string (≤ 128 chars) | Limit to one room (default: all rooms) |
| `period` | `today` \| `yesterday` \| `last_24h` \| `last_7d` \| `last_30d` | Named period in the home time zone. Alternative to from/to. |
| `from` | string (≤ 40 chars) | Range start, ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-01-15 or 2026-01-15T07:30). Without an offset it is read in the home time zone. |
| `to` | string (≤ 40 chars) | Range end, ISO 8601. Defaults to now when "from" is given. |
| `max_anomalies` | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 100) | Maximum findings returned, most severe first (default 30) |

Returns: `home`, `range`, `scale`, `requests`, `notes`, `caveats`, `rooms_analysed`, `anomaly_count`, `anomalies`, `truncated`.

## Resources

All resources are `application/json`.

| URI | Description |
|---|---|
| `netatmo://homes` | Homes with Netatmo Energy devices |
| `netatmo://homes/{homeId}/rooms` | Rooms with their IDs, types and devices. |
| `netatmo://homes/{homeId}/devices` | Thermostats, valves and gateways with model, room and gateway. |
| `netatmo://homes/{homeId}/status` | Current temperatures, setpoints, heating demand, boiler state and alerts. |

## Prompts

| Prompt | Arguments | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `heating_daily_report` | `home_id`, `date` | Summarise one day of heating: temperatures, setpoints and boiler activity. |
| `heating_anomaly_review` | `home_id`, `room_name`, `period` | Look for unusual temperatures, gaps or setpoint deviations over a period. |
| `room_comparison` | `home_id`, `period` | Compare temperatures and setpoint adherence across rooms. |
| `heating_efficiency_review` | `home_id`, `period` | Review heating patterns (setpoints, boiler demand time, overheating) for possible optimisation opportunities. |
